requirements.behavior: Parent-first lock order verified at generation commit, extraction, embedding and memory commit; deleted imported story IDs remain reserved

requirements.requirement: 明确旧备份恢复后的删除约束
requirements.behavior: Live source replay or explicitly trusted independent deletion snapshot, guarded SQL/custom restore, stale-known receipts refused, offline target on missing current evidence

deployment.adminTools: Delivered in workspace; actual CLI verified on isolated databases, not run to migrate or delete existing 3081 user stories

limits: Complete single-story package is an administrator offline operation, not a public upload endpoint; normal player reading export remains non-restorable
Legacy stories without frozen snapshots use whole-database restoration; existing or deleted story IDs are never overwritten
External URLs are retained but not fetched; login credentials, billing, account-global data and public share tokens are excluded
Independent deletion snapshot is trustworthy only when the operator supplies the latest trusted file and separately recorded digest; no real-time disaster-recovery subscription
Deletion after the last trustworthy snapshot or before tracking migrations cannot be inferred; keep target offline when required evidence is missing
Actual database and controlled-provider evidence do not close EXP-05A, full EXP-07D, OPEN decisions, real narrative quality or human acceptance
